'''''Chaenomeles speciosa''''', the '''flowering quince''', '''Chinese quince''' or '''Japanese quince''',<ref name=wfo/><ref name=Hortus>Bailey, L.H.; Bailey, E.Z.; the staff of the Liberty Hyde Bailey Hortorium. 1976. ''Hortus third: A concise dictionary of plants cultivated in the United States and Canada''. Macmillan, New York.</ref> is a thorny [[deciduous]] or semi-[[evergreen]] shrub [[native plant|native]] to [[eastern Asia]]. It is taller than another commonly cultivated species, ''[[Chaenomeles japonica|C. japonica]]'', usually growing to about {{convert|2|m|0|abbr=on}}.<ref name=wfo/><ref name=Hortus/> The flowers are usually red, but may be pink, white or green.<ref name=wfo/><ref>{{Cite web |title=RHS Chaenomeles Speciosa 'Yukigoten' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/125057/chaenomeles-speciosa-yukigotan-(d)/details |access-date= |website=RHS}}</ref> The fruit is a fragrant, hard [[pome]] that resembles a [[quince]].<ref name=Hortus/>

==Cultivation==
This plant is widely cultivated in [[temperateness|temperate]] regions for its twining habit and its showy flowers which appear early in the season, occasionally even in midwinter. It is frequently used as an informal low hedge. Numerous [[cultivars]] with flowers in shades of white, pink and red have been selected. The following cultivars and [[hybrid (biology)#Hybrid plants|hybrids]] have gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]]:<ref>{{cite web  | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants – Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 16 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 24 January 2018}}</ref>

The following [[cultivars]] have received the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]]:
*'Geisha Girl'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/29024/Chaenomeles-speciosa-Geisha-Girl-(d)/Details
| title = ''Chaenomeles speciosa'' 'Geisha Girl' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 12 April 2020}}</ref> (salmon pink)
*'Moerloosei'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/54394/Chaenomeles-speciosa-Moerloosei/Details
| title = ''Chaenomeles speciosa'' 'Moerloosei'| publisher = RHS | access-date = 12 April 2020}}</ref> (scarlet)
*'Pink Lady'<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/97837/Chaenomeles-x-superba-Pink-Lady/Details
| title = ''Chaenomeles'' × ''superba'' 'Pink Lady' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 12 April 2020}}</ref> (pink)
